decisions.question: Which evidenced enterprise Azure landing-zone management-group, connectivity, identity, policy and management anchors must Stratton join?
decisions.decision: Create a new AI-focused Azure landing zone named Citadel. Compose the Azure Landing Zone enterprise-scale platform/application structure, the Azure-Samples Foundry Citadel Platform layered AI-governance architecture and Azure Sovereign Landing Zone policy/control best practices.
decisions.accuracyBoundary: Foundry Citadel is an Azure-Samples opinionated layered AI-governance architecture. It is not a standalone Microsoft product and does not replace Azure Landing Zones. Citadel is the case-specific platform name for the composition.
decisions.supersededCandidatePosition: Reuse an existing enterprise landing zone.
remainingParameters: Final policy initiative versions after AFF-4 source resolution

decisions.question: Which subscription separation model is approved for non-production, production and independent assurance?
decisions.owner: Human architect with Enterprise Platform, Internal Audit and CISO
decisions.decision: Use three Stratton workload subscriptions: non-production, production and Internal Audit-controlled production assurance. Keep Citadel central governance/platform subscriptions separate.

citadelPlatformSubscriptions.purpose: Central management, security posture, policy evidence and platform observability; no Stratton workload data.
Primary/recovery regional hubs, Azure Firewall Premium, Private DNS Resolver and central private DNS.
Foundry Citadel-derived model, evaluation, policy and approval governance plane; no production inference endpoint or Internal Audit verdict.

decisions.separationRule: Do not merge AI governance, production workload or Internal Audit assurance ownership.

decisions.question: Which Azure locations are approved for production, backups, logs, model inference and a possible regional recovery copy?
decisions.owner: Human architect for pattern; General Counsel with DPO and CISO for exact locations
decisions.decision: Use a two-approved-region primary/recovery pattern and regional Azure AI deployments. Global and DataZone AI deployment types are prohibited.
decisions.failClosedRule: Neither region has a default. Deployment, replication, backups, logs and AI inference remain blocked until both exact region names are present in signed General Counsel/DPO/CISO evidence.
decisions.requiredBefore: Production location acceptance and any quota request

decisions.question: Which non-overlapping enterprise IPAM allocations and DNS forwarding path are approved for each environment?
decisions.owner: Human architect for topology; Network Lead for exact allocations
decisions.decision: Use enterprise hub-connected spokes with central DNS and enterprise IPAM. Citadel owns primary and recovery regional hubs in its connectivity subscription and connects them to the enterprise network.
decisions.failClosedRule: No network deployment proceeds without non-overlapping Network Lead-approved IPAM allocations and DNS forwarding records.

decisions.question: What approved concurrency, user count, document count/size/type mix, ingestion rate and AI token profile define the production sizing benchmark?
decisions.owner: Human architect for method; Chief Investment Officer and Service Operations with source owners for caps
decisions.decision: Use evidence-led elastic sizing: minimum engineering hypotheses, representative benchmarking during the first three deals, then owner-approved production caps and quotas.
decisions.failClosedRule: Initial values remain engineering hypotheses and cannot support a performance or cost acceptance claim.
